column1: Mimicking

Our only conclusion is that we're getting there, America, because the American people have put into action the President’s vision of strength, resilience, and determination. We’ve seen it time and time again—this country doesn’t back down, doesn’t give up, and doesn’t settle for less than greatness. Because of your hard work, your sacrifices, and your unwavering spirit, we’re moving forward—bigly. Together, we’re building a future that’s stronger, safer, and more prosperous than ever before. Believe me.

But as the President suggested, when we unveil the guidelines that the team has been working on tomorrow, we’ll see a clear roadmap for reopening America. It’s going to be a tremendous plan, one of the best, believe me. Some states will move faster, others will need more time—it’s all about flexibility and doing what’s right for their people. We’ve got the data, we’ve got the experts, and we’re ready to make this country stronger than ever before.

So--no, we were always going to get it. We never had a problem with it. But let’s be clear, folks, we’re talking about something massive here. Huge. And when you think about it, we’ve been ahead of the curve from day one. Nobody saw this coming, but we did. And now, we’re not just handling it—we’re winning. Big league. Because that’s what we do. We win. Always have, always will. Believe me.

All I'm saying is this: How do you close down the greatest economy in the history of the world, and then expect it to just bounce back overnight? It’s not that simple. The American people deserve leadership that understands the magnitude of what we’re dealing with here. We built this economy stronger than ever before, and now we need to rebuild it—better, smarter, and more resilient. That’s the goal, and together, we’ll get it done. Believe me.

When we think of more than 619,000 Americans having tested positive, more than 45,000 having recovered, it’s incredible—absolutely incredible. These are strong, resilient people, the greatest people in the world. And let’s not forget the doctors, the nurses, the health care workers—tremendous people doing a tremendous job. We’re fighting this virus like nobody’s ever fought before. We’re winning, we’re making progress, and we’re going to keep winning because that’s what America does best.

The next second time that I went with Dr. Birx in--to the President and said, “Mr. President, we’ve got to stay the course on this, sir,” she was very clear, very strong. “The numbers are moving in the right direction, but we can’t let up. Not now.” And the President, he looked at her, looked at me, and said, “We’re not letting up. We’re going to keep fighting, keep winning. That’s what we do, folks. We win.”

And after that, I said, "Oh, make sure that's in the bill." It was amazing And it got done, folks, because we know how to get things done. Nobody else could’ve pulled that off—nobody. Believe me, it’s huge. And let me tell you, it’s going to make a big difference, the kind of difference that’s going to save lives, create jobs, and bring this country back stronger than ever. That’s the kind of leadership you get with me, always.

But the big thing, never quit, never give up; do something you love. When you love what you do, it’s not work—it’s passion, it’s drive, it’s winning. Look, we’ve got the greatest country in the world, and we’ve got people who are fighters, who are champions. They don’t back down, they don’t fold, they push through. That’s the spirit of America. Big results come from big effort, and we’re seeing that every single day. Believe me, we’re winning.

If you're Democrat, you have automatic protection. That's years and years of people putting in efforts to make sure everything’s rigged in their favor. It’s unbelievable, folks. They’ve been doing it for decades, and nobody says a word. But when we come in, when we fight back, when we win—suddenly it’s a problem? Total hypocrisy. We’re the ones cleaning up the mess, making things fair again, and they can’t stand it. It’s always been about them, never about you, the American people.

In the last three years, ICE has arrested over 5,000 wicked human traffickers. And I will tell you, nobody does it better than us—nobody. We’ve been tough, we’ve been smart, and we’ve been relentless. These are bad people, the worst of the worst, and we’re taking them off the streets. It’s incredible, really, what we’ve accomplished. And it’s all thanks to the incredible men and women of ICE—true patriots, the best in the world. Believe me, we’re just getting started.

We've removed unnecessary restraints on our warfighters in Afghanistan. Those who risk their life and limb for our nation deserve the freedom to make decisive, tactical moves without bureaucratic red tape holding them back. We’re giving them the tools and the trust to get the job done—because winners don’t fight with one hand tied behind their back. America’s military is the strongest, the smartest, and the most capable in the world, and now, they’re even stronger. We’re not just leveling the playing field; we’re dominating it. Our enemies know it, and they’re starting to realize, once again, that they can’t mess with the United States. We’re winning, folks, and we’re going to keep winning, bigger and better than ever before.

We have a chance now to pass into law the immigration reforms that the American people have been demanding for decades. It’s time to secure our borders, protect American jobs, and ensure that only those who come here legally can stay. We’re talking about fairness, safety, and the rule of law. This isn’t just about policies—it’s about preserving the American way of life. Let’s get it done, and let’s get it done right, for the sake of every hardworking citizen in this great nation.

And I've been able to talk to many of those states. And I just remind them, look, we’ve got the best testing system in the world—nobody even comes close. We’ve done more tests than any other country, and we’re leading the way. The numbers are incredible, really incredible. And I’ve told these governors, you’ve got to stay smart, stay focused, and keep pushing forward. We’re winning this battle, folks, and we’re going to win it big.

From the instant I took office, I moved rapidly to revive the U. S. economy--slashing burdensome regulations, cutting taxes for hardworking Americans, and unleashing the full potential of our nation’s energy sector. We built the strongest economy in history, with record-low unemployment, soaring stock markets, and wages rising faster than ever before. And then, out of nowhere, the China virus hit. But we’re fighting back, rebuilding, and we’ll come back stronger than ever. Believe me.

You know, the truth is that we have coronavirus cases now in 46 American states. Which is a tough situation, very tough. But we’re handling it, believe me, we’re handling it like nobody else could. People are saying, “Mr. President, what’s the plan?” And I say, “The plan is simple: we’re going to win, we’re going to beat this virus, and we’re going to do it quickly.” We’ve got the best people, the smartest minds working around the clock, and we’re making tremendous progress. Nobody thought we’d be where we are now, but here we are, fighting hard, winning big. It’s incredible. America will come back stronger than ever, that I can promise you.

I want to speak now directly to America's children, especially those who feel lost, alone, or uncertain in these challenging times. You are not forgotten. You are the future of this great nation, and we believe in you. Together, we will overcome. We’ve faced tough moments before, and we’ve always come out stronger because that’s what Americans do. We fight, we persevere, and we never give up. Remember, you are part of something much bigger than yourself, a legacy of greatness that stretches back generations. Keep going, keep dreaming, and know that we’re all in this together. America is counting on you, and I know you won’t let us down.

The last two lines are aerosols. What does it do in the air? We have The last two lines are aerosols. What does it do in the air? We have the best scientists, the greatest minds, working around the clock to understand it. They’re doing incredible work, tremendous work. And let me tell you, we’re getting answers—big answers. It’s about how it spreads, how it lingers. We’re learning fast, and we’re acting faster. That’s how we’re going to win. Believe me, we’re going to win big.

These encouraging developments have put us in a very strong position to finalize guidelines for reopening our great nation safely and swiftly. The American people have shown incredible strength and resilience, and we’re seeing the results of their hard work. Now, we’re moving forward with confidence, guided by the best science and data, to ensure a smooth transition back to normalcy. Together, we will rebuild our economy, stronger than ever before. America will prevail, as it always does.

Very importantly, we entered into historic cooperation agreements with the governments of Mexico, Honduras, El Salvador, and Guatemala. Tremendous agreements, really. No one thought it could be done, but we did it. We’re stopping the flow of illegal immigration, protecting our borders, and keeping America safe. It’s huge. These countries are working with us like never before. They know we mean business. And guess what? It’s working. Crime is down, the borders are secure, and we’re winning. Big league. That’s what we do—we win. Nobody does it better than us. Believe me.

That's page 1,689; page 1,762. Think of it: 1,762. And that's nowhere near the end That’s right, folks. It’s huge. Tremendous. Biggest numbers you’ve ever seen. And it keeps going, because that’s what we do—we keep winning. We’re not stopping. Not now, not ever. This is America, the greatest country in the world, and we’re just getting started. Believe me, there’s more to come. More victories, more success. It’s going to be unbelievable. Just watch.

But does anybody really believe the numbers of some of these countries that you've been hearing about? I mean, come on, folks. We’ve been dealing with this for months now, and the numbers just don’t add up. They’re not being honest with us. It’s sad, really. When you look at what we’ve accomplished here in the United States—our testing, our treatments, our recovery rates—it’s unbelievable. Nobody does it better. But these other places? They’re playing games. And we’re not going to let them get away with it. Believe me.

And you'll see some data when Admiral Polowczyk gets up in just a few moments, and it’s going to be tremendous data, folks. The numbers will speak for themselves—big, powerful numbers, the kind we all want to see. We’re winning, and we’re winning big. The American people have done an incredible job, absolutely incredible. You’ve followed the guidelines, you’ve stepped up when it mattered most, and that’s why we’re seeing these results. Together, we’re turning the corner, and it’s going to be something very special. Believe me.

To the citizens of our country, serving as your president has been the honor of a lifetime. Together, we’ve built the strongest economy, the most secure borders, and a nation that’s respected worldwide. But let me tell you, we’re just getting started. The best is yet to come. We’re going to keep winning, keep succeeding, and keep making America greater than ever before. Believe me, nobody does it better than us. We’re unstoppable!

And, as you know, Europe was just designated as the hotspot right now, and we are seeing significant challenges there. But here in America, we’re making tremendous progress—tremendous. Our numbers are coming down, and we’re leading the world in so many ways. It’s a testament to the strength and resilience of the American people. We’ve done more testing than any other country, more than anyone thought possible, and we’re not stopping. We’re going to keep fighting, keep innovating, and keep winning. Because that’s what we do—we win.

A small number of social media platforms are acquiring immense power over what we can see, hear, and think. It’s unbelievable, frankly. These platforms, they control the narrative, they decide what’s true, what’s false, and who gets to speak. We’ve got to take back that power, folks. It’s about fairness, it’s about free speech, and it’s about our future. We can’t let a handful of companies dictate the destiny of this great nation. It’s time to act, and we’ll do it big.

And whether it's Kate Steinle or so many others, they'd be around today if these so-called sanctuary cities had the courage to enforce the laws we already have. It's a disgrace, really. These policies are weak, dangerous, and they put innocent lives at risk. We need strong borders, folks—strong borders—and leaders who aren’t afraid to stand up for what’s right. America deserves better. We’re talking about safety, security, and the future of this great nation.

But, for now, the best advice that we can give for people is to speak to their healthcare providers, follow the guidelines, and stay vigilant. We’re making tremendous progress, folks—tremendous. It’s important to remember that this virus is tough, but we’re tougher. We’ve got the best doctors, the best scientists, and the most dedicated people working around the clock. Trust the process, listen to the experts, and together, we’ll get through this stronger than ever before.

As long as you remain loyal, faithful, and true, then our enemies don't even stand a chance, folks. They’ll crumble, they’ll fall, because we’re stronger together. We’ve got the greatest people, the greatest nation, and we’re unstoppable. Remember, it’s about unity, about standing firm. When we do that, we win big—huge. That’s how we’ve always done it, and that’s how we’ll keep making America greater than ever before. Believe me.

The NIH, CDC, and FDA are also currently validating several antibody tests that will allow us to identify those who have been exposed to the virus and have developed immunity. This is a game-changer, folks. We’re talking about a massive step forward in our fight against this invisible enemy. These tests will help us get America back to work, back to school, and back to normal. We’re leading the world in innovation, because that’s what we do—we win, we dominate, and we deliver results like nobody else.

Good afternoon everybody. My name is Bill Bryan and I lead the Science and Technology directorate at the Department of Homeland Security. We’ve been working tirelessly, day and night, to make sure America stays ahead of the curve in combating this invisible enemy. As we’ve seen, the American people have shown incredible resilience, and because of that, we’re seeing real progress. The numbers speak for themselves—cases are stabilizing, recoveries are climbing, and we’re getting closer to turning the corner. This is a testament to the strength and unity of this nation, and we’re going to keep pushing forward, smarter and stronger than ever.

No, they say worse; they say negative. They say negative. They're going to make the numbers look bad, folks. It’s a total setup, believe me. They don’t want you to see the truth because the truth is, we’re winning. We’re doing better than anyone thought possible. They’ll spin it, they’ll twist it, they’ll do whatever they can to make it seem like we’re not succeeding. But we are. Bigly. And the American people know it—they see through the nonsense.

Likewise, we are restoring our nation's manufacturing might, even though predictions were, as you all know, that it would never happen. But we’re doing it, and we’re doing it big. Nobody thought we could bring back jobs, but we’re bringing them back in record numbers. We’re talking about millions of jobs, folks. Millions. And it’s not just any jobs—it’s high-paying, great jobs that are changing lives and rebuilding communities. We’re proving the doubters wrong every single day.

At the same time, we know that mortality and the fatalities that we're facing across the nation are devastating. But let me tell you something: we’re fighting back like never before. We’ve got the best doctors, the best treatments, and we’re getting results. People are recovering, folks. They’re coming back stronger than ever. And we’re not stopping there. We’re rolling out vaccines, we’re building supplies, and we’re going to beat this thing. Believe me, America, we’re turning the corner, and it’s going to be tremendous.

So when I got $700 billion, and then $716 billion -- and this year, it's $750 billion, it’s tremendous, folks, absolutely tremendous. We’re talking about numbers that are historic, really historic. Nobody’s ever seen anything like it. And let me tell you, we’re putting that money to work—great, great work—rebuilding our military, securing our borders, and creating jobs, the best jobs, by the way. They’re coming back, big league, because of what we’re doing. America is winning again, stronger than ever. Believe me.

Today, I am proudly announcing six brand-new initiatives to propel this new era of American innovation and prosperity. These initiatives, designed to unleash the full potential of our great nation, will create jobs, revitalize industries, and ensure America remains the global leader in technology and manufacturing. We’ve already made tremendous strides, but with these bold steps, we’re going to take it to a whole new level. Together, we will build a future that’s stronger, safer, and more prosperous than ever before. Let’s make America greater than it’s ever been!

And what you're seeing now with this order is that we're going to be able to take things to a whole new level, folks. It’s going to be tremendous, absolutely tremendous. We’re talking about big moves, the kind of moves that will make America stronger, safer, and more prosperous than ever before. You’re going to see results, fast results, because that’s what we do. We deliver, we win, and we keep on winning. Believe me, this is just the beginning.

The ongoing tragedy in Syria is heartbreaking. Our shared goals must be the de-escalation of violence and the protection of innocent lives. It’s a tough situation, folks, really tough. But we’re going to get through it together. We’ve got the best people working on it, the smartest minds, and we’re making progress. Syria is a mess, a total disaster, but we’re going to fix it. Believe me, we’re bringing stability, we’re bringing peace, and we’re going to make sure it’s done right. No more excuses.

Together with millions of hardworking patriots across this land, we built the greatest political movement in the history of our nation. Tremendous movement. People are saying it’s unbelievable, the energy, the passion—it’s like nothing we’ve ever seen before. We’re talking about real Americans, folks who love their country, who want to see it thrive, who know we can’t let it down. And we won’t. Because we’re strong, we’re united, and we’re fighting for the future of this incredible place we all call home. Believe me, the best is yet to come.

It's been a horrible time to see such death and destruction, especially when you come to a nation that we've built up so strong, so incredible—truly the greatest on Earth. But, folks, we're turning the corner. We're seeing light at the end of the tunnel. Tremendous progress, really tremendous. The vaccines, the treatments, they’re coming together like never before. We’re saving lives, we’re rebuilding, and we’re doing it faster and better than anyone thought possible. Believe me.

It was that same yearning for freedom that nearly 250 years ago gave birth to It was that same yearning for freedom that nearly 250 years ago gave birth to this great nation, the greatest nation the world has ever seen. A nation built on courage, on sacrifice, on the unshakable belief that every individual deserves the right to pursue their own destiny. That’s the American spirit—strong, bold, and relentless. And it’s that spirit that will carry us forward, no matter the challenges we face. Because America never backs down. America never gives up. We fight, we win, and we keep winning. That’s who we are. That’s what we do. And together, we’ll make this country stronger, safer, and more prosperous than ever before. Believe me.

Through four long years, you have honed your skills, trained your mind and body, overcome every obstacle, and risen to every challenge. Now, America, you stand stronger, more resilient, and more determined than ever before. We’ve built an economy that’s the envy of the world, created millions of jobs, and unleashed the full power of American innovation. Together, we’ve proven that no dream is too big, no goal too ambitious, and no challenge too great. The best is yet to come!

I was in Vietnam, and the Prime Minister and the President of Vietnam were there. And let me tell you, they were tremendous people, absolutely tremendous. We had a great discussion—very productive, very strong. They respect us, and we respect them. It’s all about making deals, and we made some of the best deals. Nobody makes deals like we do. Believe me, Vietnam knows it, and the world knows it. It’s just fantastic.

So I can only tell you what I know and what my recommendations were. But, ultimately, the decisions are up to the leaders in each state. They know their people, their communities, better than anyone. And let’s be honest, we’ve got to balance safety with keeping things moving. Nobody wants to see this economy—the greatest economy in the world—shut down again. We’re making progress, real progress, but it’s going to take smart, tough decisions to get this country back on track. America’s strength is its people, and we’ll get through this together. Believe me.

Jobs and companies are coming back to our country like never before. The power of the American worker is unmatched, it’s incredible. We’re bringing back manufacturing, we’re bringing back innovation, and we’re bringing back pride. People said it couldn’t be done, but here we are, bigger and stronger than ever. With lower taxes, fewer regulations, and a renewed spirit, America is winning again—like nobody’s ever seen. The best is yet to come, believe me.

And I don't think--I don't know who gave the orders to stop in Vietnam. But And I don't think--I don't know who gave the orders to stop in Vietnam. But what I do know is this: we had the greatest military in the world, the strongest, the most powerful, and we could’ve won, easily. It’s a disgrace how we pulled out. The decision-makers? They didn’t have the guts to finish the job. And look where that got us—everybody talks about it, still. We had the chance to show strength, to stand tall, and we walked away. It’s sad, really sad. But that’s not how we’re doing things now. No, we’re winning again, bigger than ever. Believe me.

Interestingly, we were just talking, I was talking to Doug, and the numbers they're doing are absolutely incredible. Tremendous numbers, folks, really tremendous. Doug said to me, "Sir, we’re seeing results like never before." And he’s right—because we’ve got the best people, the strongest policies, and the greatest nation on Earth. These numbers prove it. They’re historic, they’re groundbreaking, and they’re only going to get better. Believe me, we’re just getting started. America is winning, and we’re winning big.

But let me just tell you--wait. And what they're doing, because they think it is really important, is they’re focusing on the economy—unbelievable economy, by the way. They’re saying, "We’ve got to open things up, we’ve got to get people back to work." And you know what? They’re right. Because if you look at the numbers, the numbers are incredible. The jobs, the growth—it’s all there. And frankly, no one else could’ve done it like we’ve done it. No one.

I want to thank Deborah Birx, and I want to ask her maybe to come up and say a few words about the incredible progress we’re making. She’s done a tremendous job, a fantastic job, really. Nobody has worked harder than she has, and it’s not even close. The numbers are looking great, folks—better than anyone expected. We’re beating this thing, and we’re beating it big. It’s all about strength, determination, and the American spirit. We’re winning like never before!

Last year, 70,000 Americans were killed, at least -- I think the number is ridiculously underreported, folks. It's a disgrace, really. We had the greatest economy, the strongest military, the best people—nobody was doing it like us. And now, we’re supposed to accept these numbers? No way. You look at the facts, you see the truth. We’re winning, we’re coming back stronger, and we’re not going to let anyone tell us otherwise. America first, always. Believe me.

A safe and phased reopening of our economy--it's very exciting, but it does not mean we can let our guard down. Not at all. We’ve come so far, folks, and we’ve done it together. The numbers are moving in the right direction—tremendous numbers, the best numbers—but we have to stay vigilant. This is about protecting lives and livelihoods. We’re leading the way, and we’re doing it smartly. America will come back stronger than ever, believe me.

Evelyn, Elizabeth, Freddy, and Robert: Tonight, everyone in this chamber is praying for you. Everyone in America is thinking about your incredible strength, your resilience, and your courage. You’ve shown us what it means to persevere, to stand tall in the face of adversity. And let me tell you, this nation is behind you—every step of the way. Together, we will overcome. Together, we will rebuild. And together, we will make America stronger than ever before. God bless you all.

I have to say that, very excitingly, we're going to have somebody up; Bill will be up here in just a moment, and Bill has done a tremendous job—tremendous. Nobody’s done it better, believe me. He’s been instrumental in making sure everything is running smoothly, like a fine-tuned machine. People are talking about it, they’re saying, “Bill—what a guy!” And I agree, I totally agree. Big things are happening, and Bill’s a big part of it. Stay tuned, folks!

She saw it very early on, and we have -- I don't know if we She saw it very early on, and we have -- I don't know if we could have done it any better, frankly. Nobody could have seen it coming like she did. It’s incredible, really. And you know, we’ve taken action—tremendous action. The numbers are coming down, and they’re going to keep coming down because we’re doing it right. Nobody does it like us, believe me.

With every action, my administration is restoring the rule of law and reasserting the culture of fairness and justice that made America the greatest nation on Earth. We’ve taken bold steps to secure our borders, protect our industries, and empower our citizens. The left wants to tear it all down, but we’re building it up stronger than ever. Together, we’re reclaiming our future, our values, and our prosperity. This is just the beginning, folks. Believe me.

But a tremendous thing was done over the last number of months, but really, if you think about it, it’s been an incredible effort. We’ve had the best minds, the greatest experts, and the most dedicated people working around the clock to get us where we are today. And let me tell you, we’ve made tremendous strides. People are saying it’s historic, it’s unprecedented, and they’re right. We’ve shown the world what America can do when we come together, when we put our minds to it, and when we refuse to accept anything less than the best. This is what leadership looks like, and we’re just getting started. Believe me.

Well, I don't know that I had exposure, but I don't have any of the symptoms. I feel fantastic, really tremendous. Nobody knows this virus better than I do, and let me tell you, we’re doing an incredible job handling it. The numbers are looking great—better than anyone expected. We’re leading the world in testing, in recovery, in everything. People say, “Mr. President, how do you do it?” And I say, “It’s called leadership, folks.”

The Iranian government masks a corrupt dictatorship behind the false guise of a democracy. It The Iranian government masks a corrupt dictatorship behind the false guise of a democracy. It’s a shame, really, because the people of Iran deserve so much better. They deserve freedom, they deserve prosperity, and they deserve leadership that truly represents them. Instead, they’re stuck with a regime that lies, cheats, and steals from its own citizens. It’s time for the world to see the truth and stand with the brave people of Iran. We’ve seen their courage, and we know they can overcome this oppression. Together, we can support their fight for a brighter future—a future where justice and liberty prevail. The Iranian people are strong, and they won’t be silenced.

I'm the one that find them. I'm the one that settled it. Over a billion dollars—it’s huge, tremendous, nobody else could have done it. Believe me. People are saying, “How did he do it?” Simple. I know how to get things done. They come to me because I’m the best. Nobody negotiates like me. It’s a fact. And now, we’re moving forward, bigger and better than ever. America is winning again, folks. Winning big.

The core rights and values America defends today were inscribed in America's founding documents. Our forefathers envisioned a nation built on liberty, justice, and equality for all—principles that have stood the test of time and guided us through every challenge. We’ve seen unprecedented growth, unmatched innovation, and a spirit of resilience that defines the American character. Together, we’ll continue to protect and uphold these sacred ideals, ensuring a future of prosperity and freedom for generations to come. Believe me, it’s what we do best.

We'll continue our historic regulatory reduction campaign. We've--as you know, in three and a half years, we’ve eliminated more regulations than any administration in history. And we’re not stopping there. We’re cutting red tape, unleashing innovation, and creating jobs—tremendous jobs. America is thriving like never before. Businesses are booming, wages are rising, and confidence is through the roof. It’s all about putting America first, and we’re delivering results. Big results. Believe me.

Iain has always dreamed of going to space. He was the first in his class to reach for the stars, and he didn’t stop there. He worked harder than anyone, pushing boundaries, breaking records, and making it all happen. Now, with the support of an incredible team and the best technology this country has ever seen, Iain is closer than ever to achieving his dream. He’s a true inspiration—proof that with determination, America can do anything.

As just one example, I recently met the CEO of a terrific American company, Micron Technology—they’re doing incredible things, folks, really incredible. Micron is leading the way, creating jobs, and bringing innovation back to our shores. That’s the kind of American success story we need more of—strong, smart, and determined. They’re proving that when we believe in ourselves, when we invest in our people, there’s nothing we can’t achieve. America First, always.

But this is an unprecedented time. But I have to tell you: When you look at what we’ve accomplished, it’s tremendous, folks. Really tremendous. Nobody thought we could get here, but we did. It’s all because of strong leadership—the best leadership, some people are saying. We’ve taken bold steps, and look at the results. It’s incredible. With all we’re facing, we’re turning things around. America is coming back, stronger than ever. Believe me.

But I took this action early. And so the story in the New York Times But I took this action early. And so the story in the New York Times, they just don’t get it. They never do. I saw it coming, folks. I saw it clear as day. We acted, we moved fast, and we saved lives. That’s what leaders do. We didn’t wait around, we didn’t hesitate. You can’t afford to when you’re dealing with something this big, this serious. I made the tough calls, the right calls, and we’re seeing the results. The numbers, the progress—it’s all there.
